Petvity

Your pet has a signal. Now you can read it.

Open petvity.orangecat.ch → Source Ask about Petvity

One daily check-in builds a living record of a pet — what changed, when, and what a vet or sitter needs to know. A humane adoption network sits on the same records.

Products: Running and public — in beta, yours to use today.
